_standing: The Track 1 -> Track 2 hand-off. Written 2026-09-06 from the research record (H003-H009, methodology 070-074) and public literature; revised to version 3 on 2026-09-18, to version 4 on 2026-09-19 (step 8, methodology 115-118) from the oracle reply (083) and iteration 2's steps 2-6 (methodology 088, 092, 096, 097, 099, 101, 106, 109), and to version 5 on 2026-09-20 from step 8's second instrument (methodology 121 and 123, H054 supported). Coordinate-free by rule: it names the gene, the protein and the variant classes, never a position. Revised, never edited: bump `version` and append to `history`.

case._mondo_note: Open Targets resolves MVA1 to MONDO_0009759 (verified live 2026-09-06 through disease_search on the disease name); the earlier MONDO:0009551 was wrong

context_standard_of_care.note: the drugs already given for the tumour context; they can reach a high rung automatically (approved, paediatric trials) and are excluded from the repurposing shortlist because giving them is not a repurposing
context_standard_of_care.source: PMID 41749943 and 40421977 (rhabdomyosarcoma treatment landscape and maintenance regimens)

gene.protein: BubR1 (mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1 beta)

alleles.label: stop
alleles.reading: null allele: truncates BubR1 upstream of the C-terminal kinase domain

alleles.label: missense
alleles.classification: gnomAD-absent; AlphaMissense likely_pathogenic (log-likelihood-ratio lane 4.33, iteration 2 methodology 099); CADD 24.5
alleles.reading: presumed hypomorph: a partly working copy inside the C-terminal kinase domain (CDD cd14029)
alleles.structure: outside every InterPro entry typed 'domain' (inside the protein-kinase-like superfamily entry), AlphaFold pLDDT 91.06 at the residue - the model is confident about the region (iteration 2, methodology 106, H040 refuted)

mechanism.class: loss-of-function, hypomorphic (compound heterozygote: one null allele + one partly functional allele)
mechanism.status: confirmed: the oracle's reply to submission 1 is a full match at rank 1 for the stop + missense pair (methodology 083, H009 supported), so the trans configuration is the answer key's statement, not an inference
mechanism.pathway: spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) - mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC) formation and APC/C-CDC20 inhibition
mechanism.immediate_effect: reduced BubR1 abundance and checkpoint signalling; weakened kinetochore-microtubule attachment error correction
downstream: mosaic aneuploidy in dividing tissues (variegated: different chromosomes in different cells)
aneuploidy-associated proteotoxic and metabolic stress in surviving cells
cancer predisposition: rhabdomyosarcoma, Wilms tumour, leukaemia (MVA1 spectrum)
growth restriction (short stature, failure to thrive, IUGR), nephrocalcinosis
mechanism.complete_loss: embryonic lethal in mouse and human - full inhibition of BubR1 is not a therapeutic direction

literature.role: Hanks 2004: biallelic BUB1B mutations cause MVA with cancer predisposition; truncating + missense genotypes
Suijkerbuijk 2010: MVA patient cells have strongly reduced BUBR1 and a weakened SAC; missense alleles act as hypomorphs
BubR1 insufficiency, aneuploidy and premature ageing in the mouse hypomorph

repurposing_directions.name: SAC reinforcement / chromosomal-instability reduction
repurposing_directions.rationale: compensate for reduced BubR1 signalling; agents that prolong mitotic checkpoint arrest or stabilise kinetochore-microtubule attachments

repurposing_directions.name: aneuploidy-selective stress exploitation
repurposing_directions.rationale: aneuploid cells carry proteotoxic and energy stress; published aneuploidy-selective killing (AICAR-class energy stress, chloroquine-class autophagy stress, HSP90/HSF1 axis); human aneuploid cells depend on increased RNA and protein degradation (proteasome, autophagy - PMID 39247952) and mount a TFEB-driven lysosomal stress response (PMID 26404941). Caveat: this direction kills aneuploid cells - it is a tumour-context and chemoprevention angle, not a treatment of the constitutional mosaic state

repurposing_directions.name: proteostasis / BubR1 stabilisation for a hypomorph
repurposing_directions.rationale: a partly working protein can be stabilised or its turnover slowed; explore APC/C, deacetylase and chaperone routes; note BubR1 acetylation regulates its stability; SIRT2 deacetylates BubR1 (K668) and NAD+ repletion with nicotinamide mononucleotide raised BubR1 abundance in vivo and extended lifespan in BubR1-hypomorphic mice (PMID 24825348); BubR1 overexpression protects against aneuploidy and cancer (PMID 23242215); HDAC2/3 deacetylation of BubR1 silences the checkpoint (PMID 28985013)

repurposing_directions.name: cancer prevention in the MVA1 tumour context
repurposing_directions.rationale: the child's presenting tumour is rhabdomyosarcoma; approved agents with a chemoprevention or surveillance rationale in aneuploidy-driven tumours; de novo cholesterol synthesis is a non-redundant vulnerability of rhabdomyosarcoma cells (PMID 41249736)

constraints.eligibility: market-approved drugs only (challenge rules, Track 2 definition); ChEMBL max_phase 4 or an FDA label is the evidence of approval

not_used.DrugBank: licence required for programmatic access; name-dropped by the form but not queried

F8 measured by step 8: no autosome above its 2-3 % detection limit in the sequenced sample (methodology 115-118, H051-H053, H055-H057 supported; H054 open); D2's standing restated as literature-only. No rung, seed, direction or anti-direction changed (H061)

It supplies the positive control the allele route could not - one copy of X at 0.4873 and of Y at 0.5083 against 0.5 expected - puts no autosome beyond its composition-corrected null, and sets an honest floor of 1.6 % of cells. No rung, seed, direction or anti-direction changed (H065)

measured_facts.value: confirmed by the oracle (full match at rank 1, 100 rank points, F-max 1.0)
measured_facts.implication: the mechanism argument rests on a confirmed compound heterozygote; the card's biggest rigor caveat is closed

measured_facts.value: both lead alleles at one-copy multiplicity in the raw reads, posterior 1.0, read without an aligner or a caller
measured_facts.implication: a null + hypomorph genotype, not null + null: some BubR1 is made, so stabilising it (D3) is a live direction

measured_facts.value: every target-gene exon region at two copies (median 2.00 autosomal, null band [1.028, 2.823]); no exon deletion in the gene
measured_facts.implication: no hidden third allele or deletion; the two alleles are the whole genotype

measured_facts.value: 164 credible consensus structural variants genome-wide, none in the gene; 6,823 phase blocks, none reaching the gene's coding span - phase is unmeasured in the reads
measured_facts.implication: trans is the oracle's statement (F1), not a read measurement; the report says so

measured_facts.value: outside every InterPro domain-typed entry, at 95.4 % along the protein, in a region AlphaFold models at pLDDT 91.06
measured_facts.implication: 'hypomorph' rests on the allele class, the MVA1 literature and the pathogenicity predictors, not on a curated catalytic-site hit; the catalytic-dead versus unstable-protein question stays open and D3 is argued as a dosage direction, not a folding one

measured_facts.value: AlphaMissense likely_pathogenic, log-likelihood-ratio contribution 4.33 (capped at moderate); the pair leads 51,920 biallelic hypotheses over 11,465 genes with no hard filter
measured_facts.implication: quantifies 'damaging' for the partly working copy

measured_facts.value: undetermined - 5 of 50 leading alleles reach gnomAD v2 at all
measured_facts.implication: population phasing cannot corroborate F1; F1 stands alone

measured_facts.fact: aneuploidy burden in the sequenced sample
measured_facts.value: MEASURED (iteration 2, step 8) by two instruments that share nothing past the raw reads. Allele balance: no autosome carries a mosaic whole-chromosome or whole-arm aneuploidy above its own detection limit - 2 % of cells on chr1-6 and 3 % on chr7-22 at 80 % power (fold-over B-allele deviation, over-dispersion 0.0162 measured, 127,913 heterozygous-call rows); X and Y cannot be read by allele balance in a male. k-mer dosage (H054 supported, 0.85): reference-unique 31-mers counted over 32 of the 272 flowcell shards - a thinning that is unbiased for a ratio, because shards are flowcell partitions and no chromosome is over-represented in one - recovers one copy of X at 0.4873 and one of Y at 0.5083 against 0.5 expected, the positive control the allele-balance route could not supply, and puts no autosome beyond its composition-corrected null (chromosome-GC regressor, Pearson 0.904, explains 81.7 % of the between-chromosome spread; residual spread 0.802 %; largest chr21 at 2.33 sigma, Bonferroni p 0.43, and its apparent signal dissolved under tail trimming, a probe half-split and a depth check that read the excess as mismapping pileups). Honest floor: 1.6 % of cells, twice the residual spread. The absolute k-mer-mass denominator, which assumes nothing about chromosomes, is reported beside the autosomal median and agrees with it on all 24 contigs to 0.017 % (123). Sub-arm events were never testable by either route, and copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity is invisible to the dosage route. The statistic iteration 1 used (037) had no power at any fraction tested
measured_facts.implication: the sequenced sample shows no aneuploid population that a drug could be aimed at - now on two independent instruments, with X and Y covered by the second and a positive control behind it; the tissue is not named by the delivery and a karyotype's fraction is measured in cultured cells, so this is not a statement about the diagnosis. Direction D2 (aneuploidy-selective stress) therefore stays a tumour-context and chemoprevention angle argued from the literature; it cannot be argued from a measured burden in this child, and the report ranks it below D3 and D4 for that reason. The limits are stated, not closed: sub-arm events are untestable by either route, the sequenced tissue is unnamed, and copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity would move no sequence for the dosage route to see

measured_facts.value: the knowledge route placed the gene at rank 293 of 815 and its own top two genes were decoys; the fused blind ranking still put the confirmed pair first
measured_facts.implication: the drug literature is searched per drug and per direction, never trusted as a ranker on its own

anti_directions.name: further checkpoint weakening
anti_directions.agents: Mps1/TTK inhibitors, Aurora B inhibitors, MAD2/BUB1 inhibition - none market-approved
anti_directions.why: aneuploid cancer cells are selectively killed by mitotic checkpoint inhibition (PMID 33505028) - the same logic makes a constitutionally SAC-deficient child the worst candidate for it; mitotic slippage is the failure mode (PMID 30601084)

anti_directions.name: spindle poisons in a SAC-deficient background
anti_directions.agents: vinca alkaloids and taxanes - standard rhabdomyosarcoma chemotherapy
anti_directions.why: spindle poisons rely on a working checkpoint to arrest cells; MVA1 cells have a weakened checkpoint (PMID 20516114) and slip through mitosis (PMID 30601084). Flagged for the treating team as a hypothesis to weigh, never as advice to withhold standard therapy

evidence_ladder.purpose: every candidate drug is placed on one rung before it is argued; rung 1 is named, never submitted

rungs.label: approved for a related indication, with paediatric use
rungs.test: an approved drug with an openFDA label carrying a pediatric_use section or a ClinicalTrials.gov study in the tumour context that admits children

rungs.label: clinical trial in a related indication
rungs.test: a registered study of the drug in the disease or the tumour context

rungs.label: in-vivo model of aneuploidy or checkpoint deficiency
rungs.test: a cited animal result on the direction's mechanism (a PMID in evidence.tsv)

rungs.label: cell model in aneuploid or checkpoint-deficient cells
rungs.test: a cited cellular result on the direction's mechanism (a PMID in evidence.tsv)

rungs.label: mechanism only
rungs.test: the drug acts on a target in the direction's set and nothing above applies

evidence_ladder.rule: the rung is the highest test the drug passes; automated tests (approval, label, trials) and curated tests (a PMID read by a person) are printed side by side and never merged silently; a curated row may carry proxy=true when the cited result is for a same-axis compound rather than the approved molecule itself; the automated rungs 4 and 5 rest on a trial in the tumour context and therefore apply only to a direction marked context=true (the tumour-context direction) - a rhabdomyosarcoma trial says nothing about a checkpoint or proteostasis mechanism (refinement recorded in methodology 113 after the first grading run)
